issues: Scrambled/merged list markers in Article 2: items f–j are run together ("f...; g...; ... andj") instead of separate a–j entries.
Scrambled/merged list markers in Article 3: items b–e are run together ("b...; c...; ... ande") instead of separate a–e entries.
Scrambled/merged list markers in Article 4(1): sub-items a–f are run together ("right to:a" and "andf") instead of separate a–f entries; this breaks downstream boundary splitting.
Minor meaning drift/wording: "kepentingan terbaik bagi korban" is better rendered as "best interests of the victim(s)" (not "best interests of victims"), but main issue is structural.

Meaning drift in Article 4(1) opening: Indonesian grants rights to 'every victim of gender-based violence and child (victim)', but translation reads 'every victim ... and children', which changes the subject.
Minor meaning drift in Article 2 item b: 'kepentingan terbaik bagi korban' is 'best interests of the victim(s)', not singular 'the victim' (legal meaning is general).

Scrambled/merged list markers: several lettered items are run together (e.g., 'andg.', 'and/orh.', 'andf.', 'andb.', 'andc.', 'and/orf.') instead of appearing as separate a., b., c., etc. items in the same order as the original.
Minor meaning drift/terminology: 'pengundangan' is 'promulgation/enactment into the gazette', not 'promulgation ... ordered' only; keep legal sense but main fix is structural.
Markdown/list structure not faithfully preserved: some sub-items are not separated onto their own list lines, risking downstream boundary splitting.

Scrambled list/numbering structure: in the original, several lettered items are run together (e.g., 'a.' immediately after a colon; 'dan/atau' attached to the next letter; 'dan g.'), but the translation reformats them into clean separate list items, which changes the exact marker structure required downstream.

List marker fidelity: original has merged markers/text such as 'dang.' and 'dan/atauh.'; translation normalizes these to 'and g.' / 'and/or h.', which does not preserve the original marker tokens/sequence as they appear in the source Markdown.
Scrambled/incorrect list structure in Article 10: sub-items 'a.' and 'b.' are merged ('andb.') and not clearly separated as two list items, risking downstream boundary splitting.
Minor meaning drift/word choice in Article 2 point e: 'berekreasi' mistranslated as 'recreate' (should be 'recreate/recreation' as a noun/verb phrase, i.e., 'recreation').

Scrambled/merged list structure: in Article 5 and Article 7, paragraph and point markers are run together on the same line (e.g., 'Point c ... Point d ... Point e ...'), which can break downstream boundary-based parsing; they should be separated and kept in order.
Minor meaning drift/wording error: 'the right to create and recreation' should be 'the right to create and to recreate' (berkreasi dan berekreasi).
